hero.title: Hi, I'm {{name}}
hero.subtitle3: clean interfaces and smart digital products
hero.description: I turn ideas into responsive web and mobile experiences that feel polished, intuitive, and alive. My toolkit includes Figma, React, Vue, Flutter, and Python, and I love taking products from rough concept to something people actually enjoy using.

about.title: About Me
about.description1: I’m a software developer who enjoys building things that are both beautiful and useful. I care about clean structure, smooth interactions, and software that feels natural in the hands of real people.
about.description2: My background in communications gives me an advantage beyond code. I think carefully about clarity, flow, and how users actually experience a product, not just how it works under the hood. That helps me build interfaces, write better microcopy, and make digital products feel more human.
about.description3: I like working across the parts of a product that matter most: interface design, user experience, API integration, and backend logic when needed. I’m especially drawn to frontend performance, accessibility, motion, and thoughtful problem solving.
about.funFact: If something looks slightly off, I will notice it immediately.
